title: The cut title's face
note: PROJECTS at the foot of the page is a picture of type rather than type: one set of outlines, no font on the wire. The morph runs from Friz Quadrata to a second face, and this is which face. All twenty-four were previewable in the tuner and exactly one ships, because faces.json is 700 KB and the page carries one face's outlines inline.
needs: the font files, which are not in this repository, and design/cut-title/morph/faces.json - which is. Without the fonts the run stops before it writes anything.

groups.name: Which of the twenty-four
groups.note: Ranked in design/cut-title/morph/ranking.csv, with a blurb each in faces.json. The four kinds the tuner grouped them by - grotesk, display, soft, geometric - are fields on those entries rather than an axis here.

params.label: face
params.note: The face the word morphs INTO. At t = 0 every one of them is identical, because they are all Friz there.
